answer: Because the inlet solution is checked at the horizon gate and logged, the canyon audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 27 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. The deposit is 65 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
